from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareholdersEquityRecord(BaseModel):
    """One recorded equity figure from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the report belongs to")
    report_year: str | None = Field(description="The year this report covers, e.g. '2019'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The specific period of the report, e.g. 'Q1'")
    equity_date: str | None = Field(description="The date this equity figure represents, e.g. '2019-03-31'")
    equity_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of equity: 'total' for total shareholders' equity, 'parent' for parent company portion")
    equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="The equity amount as a numeric value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. 'CNY' or 'RMB'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Brief description or label for this equity figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[ShareholdersEquityRecord]
